records.memeStoryText: HANSOME ALPACAS ($HANSOME) is a community-driven meme coin on Robinhood Chain — an animal-meme character (the “too handsome” alpaca) with a fixed supply and no utility promises. It exists as culture-first internet meme / community identity on the chain, not as a company pitch. Official home: hansomealpacas.xyz.
